Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with her building blocks and dolls. One day, she was playing with her blocks when her brother came in and knocked them down. 

Lily felt sad because she was her brother and did not want to understand why she could explain. Her brother felt bad and went over to play. Lily said, "Please stop crying and play with me to play." 

Her brother decided to be nice and said, "Sure, Lily. You're my best friend." Lily felt happy and shared her blocks with her brother. They played together
